newsitem.title: INDIA: Good demand for all grades at Calcutta tea auction.
newsitem.headline: Good demand for all grades at Calcutta tea auction.

text.p: The Calcutta tea auction witnessed good demand for all grades this week, traders said.
In all 66,879 packages, including 5,177 packages of Darjeeling tea, were on offer.

In CTC variety, best liquoring Assam was dearer, while plain and medium Assam were firm. Major blenders were active, traders said. In Orthodox variety, all clean whole leaf and brokens were firm, while fannings were dearer.
In Dust category, all sorts were firm to dearer, mainly brighter liquoring varieties. Major blenders were active, traders said.
